caveats: H.J.Res.88 roll call number not found; Slotkin's Yea (only Democrat) confirmed by her May 22, 2025 release and news reports.
Economy combines the tax-credit pledge (H.R.1, contradicted) and the no-EV-mandate pledge (H.J.Res.88, delivered); scoring them as separate issues would change the result.
Foreign policy rated not testable; reports on her Apr 15, 2026 Israel arms-sale votes (S.J.Res.32, S.J.Res.138) conflict, and she missed the July 2025 votes.
